title: ai_video_ack — Video Frame Acknowledgement
description: Server acknowledges receipt and processing of a client video frame. The sliding-window ack_frame_id allows the client to detect frame loss (gap > 1) and skip already-confirmed frames.

ack_frame_id.description: Sliding-window acknowledgement: the highest frame_id processed so far. Client detects loss when ack_frame_id - last_sent_frame_id > 1.

processed.description: true = frame was fed to the multimodal LLM. false = frame was discarded (e.g., session was in SPEAKING state, visual processing disabled).
